purpose: Conditional learned shared-state feasibility; compare with exactly parameter-matched dense controls. Not a new-MoE or large-scale superiority claim.
checkpoint_selection: Always step 600, no best-development/test checkpoint selection.
audit_policy: Freeze all 24 checkpoint hashes before generating audit; fresh sequences, known rule-symbol mappings. Report every seed.
primary: Paired-seed audit answer-token NLL and accuracy versus exact-parameter dense; median and full seed range, not asymptotic capacity.
inference_contract: Local causal soft routing in FFN only; attention remains unchanged; no full expert matrix materialization; no sparse compute claim.
kv_gate: Full vs cached logits max absolute difference <= 0.00005; answer argmax unchanged.
reproduction: One MN002 run re-executed in a separate process; compare metrics/state tensors excluding wall time.
no_hidden_tests: Report finite-table fitting only; not unseen rule-symbol generalization, natural language or proof of unlimited states. Primary no hyperparameter sweep.
matched_control_note: At d=hidden=32, mirror S is exactly matched in trainable scalars and FFN linear MACs by dense hidden=32+S. Direct-gate hidden32 is +32 scalars vs mirror16, with equal linear MACs. Nonlinear/softmax runtime is not matched.
